items.title: Cavalry lift CPL Shield as 2026 regular season winners | HIGHLIGHTS
items.headline: The Cavs top the CPL table for a third time
items.summary:
Cavalry FC are the Canadian Premier League's 2026 regular season winners.

items.headline: The CPL's newest club is postseason-bound.

items.title: Pacific find a comeback draw against Forge to close out campaign | HIGHLIGHTS
items.headline: Pacific rescued a draw against Forge to end the season on a high note in front of their fans.
items.summary:
Days after their special Canadian Championship triumph, Forge just missed out on another trophy on Sunday, as they drew 1-1 with Pacific at Royal Athletic Park to finish the regular season in second place, missing out on the CPL Shield to Cavalry by two points.
